translations.web: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
translations.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
translations.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
translations.asv: Faithful is the saying, If a man seeketh the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
